subject.title: 飞书消息回复引用(replyTo)有时不显示 - OpenClaw 2026.3.23-2

question: Should maintainers continue this Feishu reply-anchor work through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/78964, sponsor a narrower credited replacement, or reopen a new automated fix for only explicit `replyTo` on ordinary `send`?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but an overlapping proof-supplied PR is already open, conflicting, and carries routing blockers, while this issue is labeled not to queue another independent fix PR.

options.title: Repair The Existing Anchor PR
options.body: Rebase or repair https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/78964 so it preserves current normal-group and P2P invariants while carrying the reply-anchor fix.

options.title: Sponsor A Narrow Replacement
options.body: Open a smaller credited replacement that fixes ordinary `send` `replyTo` forwarding first and leaves broader topic-anchor work to separate review.

options.title: Queue A New Focused Fix
options.body: Remove the no-new-fix-pr constraint and let automation attempt only the explicit `replyTo` action-layer mapping with focused Feishu channel tests.

recommendation.title: Repair The Existing Anchor PR
recommendation.body: Rebase or repair https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/78964 so it preserves current normal-group and P2P invariants while carrying the reply-anchor fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work by this contributor touched the affected Feishu channel action and native-card send surfaces, making them the best available routing owner for the maintainer choice.
